zh.title: 通用電氣航太獲美國國防部合約開發5馬赫極音速測試載具
zh.summary: 通用電氣航太獲國防創新單位合約；開發5馬赫極音速載具；預計2028年首飛
body: 通用電氣航太（GE Aerospace）已獲得美國國防創新單位（Defense Innovation Unit, DIU）頒發之合約，將負責開發一款速度可達5馬赫的空中發射極音速測試載具。該款採用液態燃料的測試載具被命名為「Derecho」，將結合火箭推進器與由通用電氣航太雙模式衝壓發動機技術驅動的巡航器。
整套Derecho載具將作為美國國防部「極音速與高頻次空中測試能力」（Hypersonic and High-Cadence Airborne Testing Capabilities, HyCAT）計畫之測試平台。通用電氣航太表示，最新獲得的合約將用於資助該載具的全機整合，以及關鍵子系統的首批資格認證與組件級測試。該公司並未公開此項國防合約的具體金額。
根據規劃，通用電氣航太目標於2028年進行Derecho載具的首次飛行測試，這也將是該公司首次在飛行中展示液態燃料雙模式衝壓發動機技術。雙模式衝壓發動機具備兼具傳統衝壓發動機與超音速燃燒衝壓發動機（scramjet）的功能，使其能在更廣泛的超音速與極音速飛行速度範圍內運作。
由於該發動機利用大氣中的氧氣進行燃燒而非自行攜帶氧化劑，此項設計有助於提升測試載具的燃料或酬載能力。Derecho的初始配置將暫不包含轉動爆震燃燒系統，但相關技術未來可能被納入該測試平台的後續升級版本中。
通用電氣航太最初於2023年透過其在2022年收購的Innoveering公司參與HyCAT計畫，並於2025年完成全套載具的初步設計審查。美國國防部推動HyCAT計畫旨在提高極音速飛行測試的頻率並降低相關成本，用以支援能在極音速狀態下搭載實驗性推進系統、感測器、通訊設備及導引技術之測試載具開發。

en.title: GE Aerospace Secures Pentagon DIU Contract for Mach 5 Hypersonic Test Vehicle
en.summary: GE Aerospace wins US Defense contract to develop Mach 5 hypersonic test vehicle for 2028 flight test.
body: GE Aerospace has received a contract from the US Defense Innovation Unit (DIU) to develop an air-launched hypersonic test vehicle capable of reaching Mach 5. Known as Derecho, the liquid-fueled vehicle will combine a rocket booster with a cruiser powered by GE Aerospace's dual-mode ramjet technology. The integrated vehicle will serve as an airborne testing platform for the Pentagon's Hypersonic and High-Cadence Airborne Testing Capabilities (HyCAT) program.

According to statement details released by GE Aerospace, the latest contract will fund full vehicle integration alongside initial qualification and component-level subsystem testing for key flight components. The company did not disclose the specific monetary value of the Pentagon defense contract. The initiative supports national defense priorities through scalable hypersonic testing capabilities.

The aerospace manufacturer is targeting 2028 for the initial flight of the Derecho vehicle, which will mark its first flight demonstration of liquid-fueled dual-mode ramjet technology. Dual-mode ramjets are designed to function as both conventional ramjets and scramjets, allowing efficient operation across a wide operational spectrum of supersonic and hypersonic speeds.

By utilizing atmospheric oxygen for internal engine combustion rather than carrying an onboard oxidizer, the propulsion system design allows test vehicles to carry additional fuel or larger payloads. Derecho's initial baseline configuration will not include rotating detonation combustion technology, though the subsystem could potentially be integrated into future production variants of the test platform.

GE Aerospace originally began working on the HyCAT program in 2023 following its 2022 acquisition of Innoveering, advancing through preliminary design review in 2025. The overarching HyCAT program is structured to increase testing frequency while lowering operational costs for hypersonic flight research. This platform supports airborne evaluation of experimental propulsion systems, sensors, communications hardware, and guidance technologies.

zh.title: 美國空軍調配F15EX與打擊鷹戰機部署
zh.summary: 美國空軍部署F15EX戰機並將打擊鷹移至匿蹤轟炸機基地
body: 根據Simple Flying於2026年9月3日的報導，美國空軍正在調整其戰術部署，計畫將F-15EX戰機派遣至西摩強森基地，並將打擊鷹戰機移往一座B-2匿蹤轟炸機基地。F-15EX戰機在美軍未來架構中扮演重要角色，且與B-21轟炸機具備互補性。
此外，根據2026年8月的歷史紀錄，美軍正尋求在2027財年退役149架軍機，包括20架F-15E以釋出資金。與此同時，美軍已將次世代F-15EX的採購目標提升至267架並增加生產投資。

en.title: US Air Force to Deploy F-15EXs to Seymour Johnson and Strike Eagles to B-2 Base
en.summary: US Air Force is deploying F-15EX fighters and relocating Strike Eagles to a B-2 stealth base.
body: According to Simple Flying on September 3, 2026, the United States Air Force is deploying F-15EX fighter jets to Seymour Johnson Air Force Base, while sending F-15E Strike Eagles to a B-2 stealth bomber base. The F-15EX is considered complementary to the B-21 bomber and plays a critical role in the Air Force's future force structure.

Additionally, historical records from August 2026 show that the Air Force requested to retire 149 aircraft in Fiscal Year 2027 to free up funding, which includes 20 F-15E jets. Meanwhile, the military has raised its next-generation F-15EX procurement target to 267 units.

zh.title: 卡達航空接收無Qsuite波音787-9並補償旅客
zh.summary: 卡達航空接收未配備Qsuite的波音787-9，並為受影響旅客提供退款。
body: 根據 Simple Flying 於 2026 年 9 月 3 日的報導，卡達航空正在接收未配備其招牌 Qsuite 商務艙的波音 787-9 客機。針對被安排搭乘這些特定客機的旅客，該航空公司將提供退款。
這些波音 787-9 客機改為採用 Ascent 商務艙座椅，該座椅的特點是比標準的 Qsuite 更輕且更窄。作為背景資料，卡達航空先前於 2026 年 8 月首度將配備 Starlink 的波音 787-9 投入服務，並計劃在 2026 年底前完成整個波音 787 機隊的衛星網路部署。

en.title: Qatar Airways Accepts Boeing 787-9s Without Qsuite, Refunding Passengers
en.summary: Qatar Airways accepts Boeing 787-9s without Qsuites and refunds affected passengers.
body: Qatar Airways is accepting Boeing 787-9 aircraft configured without its standard Qsuite business class cabins. According to a report by Simple Flying on September 3, 2026, the airline is offering refunds to passengers who are assigned to fly on these specific Dreamliner aircraft.

Instead of Qsuites, these Boeing 787-9 aircraft utilize Ascent business class seats, which are described as being lighter and narrower. As background, Qatar Airways previously debuted its first Starlink-equipped Boeing 787-9 in August 2026, and the carrier expects to complete the satellite internet rollout across its entire Boeing 787 fleet by the end of 2026.

zh.title: JCB Aero取得波音Part 145維修認證
zh.summary: JCB Aero獲波音Part 145認證；將服務波音737系列
body: JCB Aero宣布，在取得新的波音（Boeing）Part 145維修認證後，其維修、修理和大修（MRO）能力獲得擴展。該公司位於法國奧什（Auch），鄰近土魯斯（Toulouse），是AMAC Aerospace旗下企業，自2024年10月起開始營運MRO業務，先前已為空中巴士（Airbus）飛機完成多個維修專案。
該波音認證於2026年8月取得，涵蓋波音B737飛機的基地與航線維修，包括波音737-600、737-700、737-800與737-900型號。JCB Aero營運長Sébastien Kubler表示，獲得此認證是公司MRO業務發展的重要里程碑。公司已開始提供報價，未來數月將迎接多架波音飛機進廠。

en.title: JCB Aero receives Boeing Part 145 maintenance approval
en.summary: JCB Aero gains Boeing Part 145 approval; will extend MRO to Boeing 737 family
body: JCB Aero has announced the extension of its Maintenance, Repair and Overhaul (MRO) capabilities following the receipt of a new Part 145 maintenance approval for Boeing aircraft.

Located in Auch, near Toulouse, JCB Aero (an AMAC Aerospace company) launched its MRO operations in October 2024. The Boeing approval received in August 2026 covers Base and Line Maintenance on Boeing B737 aircraft, including the B737-600, B737-700, B737-800 and B737-900 variants. Sébastien Kubler, Chief Operating Officer at JCB Aero, said the approval marks an important milestone. JCB Aero has begun issuing quotations and will be welcoming several Boeing aircraft to its hangar in the coming months.

zh.title: 亞航首度代碼共享合作夥伴飛馬航空 開闢五歐洲目的地
zh.summary: 亞航與飛馬航空代碼共享啟動；吉隆坡經伊斯坦堡通往五歐洲城市
body: 亞航集團宣布與土耳其低成本航空公司飛馬航空建立首度代碼共享合作夥伴關係，雙方於2026年9月2日正式簽署協議，將亞航在東南亞與亞洲的廣泛航點網絡，透過伊斯坦堡薩比哈·格克琴國際機場（SAW）連接飛馬航空覆蓋的歐洲航線。
此代碼共享首階段開放五個歐洲目的地，旅客可從吉隆坡國際機場（KUL）經伊斯坦堡前往莫斯科伏努科沃國際機場（VKO）及雅典國際機場（ATH）等城市，採單一機票與聯程託運行李，無需在伊斯坦堡轉機時提取並重新辦理行李。
為支撐擴展聯運，亞航計畫將吉隆坡至伊斯坦堡航班頻率由每週四班增至每週七班，預計2027年2月實現每日一班；亞航X早於2025年11月已開航吉隆坡直飛伊斯坦堡航線。
亞航集團執行長Bo Lingum表示，此合作是亞航邁向「真正全球旅遊網絡」的重要里程碑，正值亞航成立25週年；飛馬航空執行長Gulis Ozturk則強調伊斯坦堡作為歐亞天然樞紐的優勢，雙向聯運將惠及雙方旅客。
配合啟動，亞航推出優惠單程票價，吉隆坡經伊斯坦堡飛五歐洲目的地最低馬幣799元（約180美元），歐洲反向飛吉隆坡最低199美元，倫敦史坦斯特最低299美元；優惠購票期9月2日至6日，適用出發至2027年3月27日，含稅費與20公斤託運行李額度，可透過AirAsia MOVE平台訂購。

en.title: AirAsia launches first codeshare with Pegasus, opens five European destinations
en.summary: AirAsia partners with Pegasus on first codeshare; five European cities via Istanbul from Kuala Lumpur
body: AirAsia Group announced its first-ever codeshare partnership with Turkish low-cost carrier Pegasus Airlines on September 2, 2026, linking AirAsia's extensive network across ASEAN and Asia with Pegasus' European reach via Istanbul Sabiha Gökçen International Airport (SAW).

The codeshare initially opens five European destinations accessible from Kuala Lumpur International Airport (KUL) via Istanbul, including Moscow Vnukovo (VKO) and Athens (ATH). Passengers can travel on a single ticket with through-checked baggage, eliminating the need to reclaim and recheck luggage during the Istanbul stopover.

To support the expanded connectivity, AirAsia will increase the frequency of its Kuala Lumpur-Istanbul route from four to seven flights per week by February 2027, making it a daily service. AirAsia X first launched direct flights between Kuala Lumpur and Istanbul in November 2025.

AirAsia Group CEO Bo Lingum called the partnership a significant milestone in the airline's 25th anniversary year, describing it as a new chapter in AirAsia's evolution into a truly global travel network. Pegasus Airlines CEO Gulis Ozturk said the collaboration reflects the strength of Pegasus' network built from Istanbul over two decades, calling Sabiha Gökçen Airport a natural link between Europe and Asia.

To mark the launch, AirAsia is offering promotional one-way fares from Kuala Lumpur to the five European destinations via Istanbul starting from MYR 799 (US$180). Fares from Europe to Kuala Lumpur start from US$199 one-way, with London Stansted fares from US$299. The promotion runs from September 2 to 6, 2026, for travel through March 27, 2027, and includes departure fees, fuel surcharges, and a 20 kg checked baggage allowance. Bookings can be made through the AirAsia MOVE platform.
